Subject: Post-discovery recap + next step: 30m product intro

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap from our call so we all have the same north star:
- Main pain: slow retrieval + high inference cost on long-context retrieval workflows.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms median generation for 1k-context summaries, predictable cost per call, audit logs for queries.
- Stakeholders interested: Product (you), Security (David Li), and an engineering SME for infra questions.

Next step: 30-minute product intro where we walk through a compact demo + ops/infra readiness checklist. Could you confirm which of these three 30-minute windows works best for your team (all times in PDT):
1) Tue, Oct 28 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT (11:00–11:30 MT)
2) Thu, Oct 30 — 2:00–2:30 PM PDT (5:00–5:30 PM EDT)
3) Fri, Oct 31 — 9:00–9:30 AM PDT (UTC-7)

If none work, share two times that fit your stakeholders and we’ll adapt. Also: please call out the engineering attendee we should include and the security contact (we’ll pull SOC2 summary and a brief attestation).

Attachments: 2025-10-23-Redwood-Intro-Deck.pdf (slide deck) — quick preview of topics well cover.

Thanks — aim to keep it tight and demo-driven.

— Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
